# HudSpec.ShouldRender property

The single source of visibility truth (`hide = !ShouldRender()`, evaluated each apply ~10 Hz). Compiler-`required`: every [`HudSpec`](../HudSpec.md) MUST set it or the build fails. A gameplay HUD typically uses `() => _services.ClientState.Phase == GamePhase.World && (_services.ClientState.UiState & GameUIState.GameHudHidden) == 0`.

public Func<bool> ShouldRender { get; set; }
